name: Import/Export
description: Multi-format data import and export with template-based mapping

service.description: ImportExportService for managing import/export operations, including synchronous process_import_job/process_export_job

router.description: API endpoints for import/export CRUD operations

handler_extension_point.description: ModuleInterface.get_import_export_handler() — a module must implement ImportExportHandler (app.core.import_export.handler) to actually support bulk import/export. Only 'tasks' does as of this version; other modules' jobs are created but processed to status=failed with an explanatory error. GET /import-export/supported-modules exposes only modules that implement this hook (self-discovering, no manual list to maintain here); the frontend module picker sources from that endpoint instead of listing every enabled module.

events.description: safe_publish_event() calls inline in ImportExportService — the ImportExportEventPublisher class in events.py exists but is unused (dead code)

permissions.description: RBAC permissions (view, import, export, manage) — matches app.core.auth.permissions MODULE_ROLES for internal.viewer/importer/exporter/manager

features.csv_import: Import data from CSV files with column mapping — functional for modules implementing ImportExportHandler (currently: tasks)
features.excel_import: Import data from Excel workbooks (.xlsx) — parsing exists; real handler wiring same as csv_import
features.csv_export: Export data to CSV format — functional for modules implementing ImportExportHandler (currently: tasks)
features.excel_export: Export data to Excel format with formatting — same scope as csv_export
features.pdf_export: Accepted by the export_format field but process_export_job does not yet route to PDFExporter — known gap, not fixed
features.template_mapping: Backend create/list/download-template endpoints are real and functional; no frontend UI exists to manage them yet
features.handler_extension_point: ModuleInterface.get_import_export_handler() — modules must implement this to support import/export; only 'tasks' does as of this version
features.tenant_isolation: All import/export operations isolated by tenant

performance.processing_model: synchronous, in-request — no background worker exists (backend/app/tasks/__init__.py is an empty Celery stub)
performance.progress_tracking: job.status field only (pending -> processing -> completed/failed, set synchronously within the same request); import.completed/import.failed/export.completed events published on finish for external consumers

1.1.0.changes: Added the real job-processing pipeline (process_import_job/process_export_job) and the ModuleInterface.get_import_export_handler() extension point, with 'tasks' as the first real handler. Previously, jobs were created and permanently stuck at status=pending with no data ever actually imported or exported. Deduplicated DataExporter to delegate to exporters/*.py. Corrected this file and contracts.yaml, which had previously and incorrectly claimed async_processing=true and status=production.

1.0.0.changes: Initial implementation with CSV/Excel support, template system. Note: despite the original changelog entry claiming 'async batch processing', no such processing was ever implemented — jobs were created but never processed.
